features.name: Fix evaluation seeding, utilisation logging, and range consistency
features.description: (a) Replace dap/stats.py build_trajectory_seeds with hash(prompt_id, trajectory_index) seeds over a disjoint index space so stage-1/stage-2 top-ups never collide (dap/e2/runner.py _eval_specs and the top-up path); (b) log per-trajectory utilisation Z/max(0,B) and per-step activity counts (theta==0, 0<theta<1, theta==1) in E1 and E2 aggregates; (c) use one range parameter everywhere (Z is in [0,K]); (d) add --use-chat-template flag that wraps prompts with the risky tokenizer's chat template. Add tests/test_seeds.py (no duplicate seeds across a 4+16 split for 1000 ids) and tests/test_invariant.py (Z <= max(0,B)+1e-3 on a saved log sample).

features.name: Baselines and copying metrics in E1
features.description: E1 accepts k in {-1, 0} (risky-only, safe-only) with K reported as inf/0 and no certification arithmetic; adds longest common substring (word and char), accumulated common substring, and nv-recall against the reference to every record; adds --k-values -1 0 0.1 0.15 0.25 0.5 1 3 5 support with a --trajectories-per-prompt override. Smoke test on DGX with caps=2.

features.name: Regime sweep on DGX (C2)
features.description: Run E1 on the Stage-1 prompt set (caps 200/150/150/100/150/150) at k in {-1, 0, 0.1, 0.15, 0.25, 0.5, 1} with 3 trajectories per prompt, chat template on and off for the instruct model. Produce results/regime_sweep.csv (per k: % active steps, % identical to k=-1 output, forced-safe leading tokens, ROUGE-L, LCS, nv-recall) and figures/regime_sweep.pdf.

features.name: Certificate-strength audit (C3)
features.description: analysis/certificate_cap.py: for every CopyBench reference (attack_train, val, test) compute S(x) = -ln p_s(reference | prefix) with TinyComma, and the cap min(1, (K+ln2)/S) for K in {20,30,50,100,200,600,1000}. Output results/certificate_caps.csv (per-passage S and caps) and figures/certificate_cap_curve.pdf (fraction of passages with vacuous certificate vs k). Include the best-of-n equivalence (K nats ~ best-of-e^K) as a labelled axis.
features.evidence: .venv/bin/python analysis/certificate_cap.py --data data --out results && head results/certificate_caps.csv && ls figures/certificate_cap_curve.pdf

features.name: Memorising risky model
features.description: Provide a risky model that regurgitates CopyBench passages when unconstrained: either meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B (base) if it fits the DGX, or Llama-3.1-8B fine-tuned for a few epochs on the 16 CopyBench novels' excerpts (train on attack_train and val sources only; test split held out). Verify greedy and sampled extraction at k=-1 (nv-recall >= 0.8 on training passages). Save recipe under recipes/memorizing_model.md; do not commit weights.

features.name: Composition attack (C5b)
features.description: analysis/composition_attack.py: split each memorised passage into L-token windows (L in {20,50}), query each window's true prefix (and the previously extracted prefix) under anchored decoding at k in {0.15, 0.5, 1, 3}, stitch, and report per-query KL spend (must be <= K) alongside total nv-recall and longest reconstructed span. Output results/composition.csv and figures/composition.pdf. Include k=-1 and k=0 baselines.

features.name: Bank-and-burst attack and LCS-objective search (C5a)
features.description: Construct prompts whose first ~150 generated tokens are content on which risky and safe models agree (bank ~150k nats), followed by a memorised continuation; log banked budget at the pivot, per-step spend after it, and verbatim span. Repurpose dap/e2 optimizer with objective = longest common substring with the reference at fixed k; remove the surrogate, k-DPP, and the 'stay within budget' instruction. Output results/bank_burst.csv and figures/bank_burst.pdf.

features.name: Format-evasion attack (C5d)
features.description: All-caps, hyphenated, and translated regurgitation prompts (Ippolito et al. 2023) with the memorising model at k in {0.15, 1}; report KL cost of the format change and overlap before and after normalisation. Output results/format_evasion.csv.

features.name: Safe model is not safe (C5e)
features.description: Select 50 Project Gutenberg passages present in the Common Pile; run anchored decoding at k=0 (safe model only) and k=0.15; report nv-recall and LCS. Output results/safe_model_copying.csv.
